findings.finding: Algebraic spread increase was phrased as widening despite a shallower inversion.
findings.fix: Changed widened to increased; retained exact Treasury quantities and steepening description.

findings.finding: The headline phrasing about Ellison clinching control risked implying that the Paramount transaction had closed.
findings.fix: Specified the announced agreement to merge and added directly reviewed CNBC agreement headline n0913.

findings.finding: Post-earnings headwind commentary was attributed only to CNBC without naming the commentator in the source title.
findings.fix: Attributed that view to Jim Cramer via CNBC; retained separate reported Constellation Brands outlook improvement.

findings.finding: Powell confirms could read as completed testimony although all body language correctly kept the event pending.
findings.fix: Changed title to Powell could preserve a conditional easing path.

findings.finding: Merged edition contained five n0849 markers, though NR alone met its cap.
findings.fix: Removed redundant marker only; retained the same supported guidance claim and two direct NR source placements. See reviewed_revisions.

claim_checks.result: Verified Treasury 4.62%/4.28%/-34 bps and twenty-observation -10/0/+10 bps against the exact Treasury fields. Verified S&P 500 versus Nasdaq 100 identities and all local equity, sector ETF, commodity and credit ETF values/horizons to the completed 2024-07-08 own card. DXY five-session -0.81% is not mistaken for its positive twenty-session move. TSM is explicitly US ADR; Intel 33.99 USD/+6.15%/+11.74% checked. BTC/ETH completed 2024-07-08 UTC daily observations are distinct from equity trading hours. June payroll and PMI numbers match cited complete titles.

Read all 96 cited complete headlines, including added merger-agreement headline. Macro trade, housing, wages, tax, policy and consumption baselines fit 35 days; current legal, political and company news fits seven days; outlook/earnings updates are already reported. Powell testimony and CPI remain pending and conditional. Exxon indication retains the excluding-Pioneer qualifier, rather than being presented as completed combined-company earnings. BYD Turkish production is a plan, R&F petition is not completed liquidation and GLP-1 study is not a new approval.

Goldman hedge-fund commodity-stock buying is an attributed defined-group flow observation, distinct from Calastone fund channels and tech-heavy mutual-fund composition. ACME IPO filing is a financing request; Emcure bids are offering-specific. Biedronka/Dino searches and suspicions do not establish guilt or fines; Duda NATO position does not become accession. BofA power-demand view remains an analyst outlook. Constellation Brands and Constellation Energy remain distinct entities.

Bullish US/technology/SOXX and selective power thesis require commercial proof and cash conversion. Mixed financial, energy and China positions are consistent with margin, funding and household constraints. Bearish autos/BMW has explicit improvement/cover conditions. Anticipatory blocks specify conditional expressions and failure conditions without treating future releases as known.

style_depth.assessment: All 36 blocks carry date-specific evidence and relevant causal tests. CN compares central-bank instrument control with private credit demand, resale versus developer cash, legal distress and production-location tariff risk. PL integrates wage support, inflation, legal retail uncertainty, governance, security cooperation and project funding, ending in a substantive divergence. Equipment, energy, health and optical themes distinguish market attention from earnings delivery. No substantial rewrite was needed.
style_depth.limits: Headline evidence cannot establish article-body detail, private positions, future customer behavior or realized future results; the draft stays at stated headline facts and conditional mechanisms.
